enchantments.tooltip: Intelligence +14: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Quality Combat Mastery +3: +3 Quality bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Quality Deception +3: +3 Quality bonus to hit and +5 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Quality Deadly +3: +3 Quality bonus to weapon damage.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
